tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi sgrub pa las gsungs pa'i zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi sgrub pa las gsungs pa'i zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi sgrub pa las gsungs pa'i zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag cing khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi dbyings// sku gsum snang cha ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs// smon lam dbang gis 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad// bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'dud// ngan 'gro'i mun nag stug por 'khyams pa'i 'gro /skyob phyir bla ma'i man ngag zab mo'i 'od// brtse ba'i shing rta yis drangs zer 'phros pas// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed 'di na bshad// de yang slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis rgyud lung du ma'i dgongs pa bkral ba'i man ngag na raka dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs 'di ni sgrib pa sbyong zhing tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs du ma'i nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don du 'di la 'jug pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la drug las/ dang po yo byad bsham pa ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su bdag bskyed bsnyen pa'i skabs sman raka gtor gsum tsam la brten/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i skabs su dkyil 'khor sa thig chog dang bcas 'bri ba'am ras bris bkram la sku gzugs gang 'byor bsham pa'i mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor zhing skong chog byed na dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sman raka gtor gsum mar me lha grangs tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas bsham/ dbang dang 'brel na dbus su bum pa bcud ldan chas kyis spras pa byang shar du khrus bum dbang rdzas sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bya/ tshogs gsag pa ni sgrub pa po rnams stan bde bar 'khod la dad pa dang nges 'byung snying rje dang ldan pas brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab/ byin rlabs bcu gcig skabs su gang bab song rjes gzhi bdag gtor ma gtong la tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ yan lag brgyad pa song rjes bgegs gtor btang la bka' bsgo zhing phyir bskrad/ gnyis pa srung 'khor sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: yang dag lta ba'i ngang nyid las:

khro bo'i sprin kun 'dus pa yis: bgegs dang log 'dren tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus rdo rje'i gur khang che: me rlung chu yi rim pas bskor: kun kyang gzhom du med par bsam: badzra raṃ yaṃ khaṃ rakṣa: gsum pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ bshags yul gsal btab la/ hūm̐: ye nas gnyis med chos skur dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin: de ldog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzhi pa dam bca' bzung ba ni/ hūm̐: kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi: byang chub mchog tu bdag ni sems bskyed do: don dam dang ni kun rdzob byang chub sems: bla ma lha khyod rtag tu bzung bar bgyi: rgyas par ye shes sku mchog dang rnal 'byor dbang po sogs bya/ lnga pa byin 'bebs pa ni/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ hūm̐ a la la ho: bha ga wān sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mthu chen bdud thul bcom ldan 'das: byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drug pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor bkrus: bdud rtsi'i snod ni gzhal yas khang: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir dam rdzas bcu: sa bon phyag mtshan rigs lnga'i sku: yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsir zhu: bhandha bdud rtsir oṃ gyis mtshan: rgya gram rta mgrin yum bzhis mnan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sbyor ba'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi bskul: 'od zhu bdud rtsir dbyer med 'dres:

gtor gzhong bhandha'i nang du ni: gtor ma oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: padma bhañdza'i snod nang du: ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: snod mchog zhing khams phun tshogs pa: mchod pa'i lha mo'i rol par bsam: na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim sgom pa la bdun las/ dang po byang chub sems gnyis bskyed pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang: rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba las: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang: skye 'gag gnas dmigs 'gro 'ong bral: gnyis pa ting 'dzin gsum gyis khog phub ste bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: ye shes 'od gsal kun la khyab: zung 'jug ngo bo a ru gsal: cho 'phrul e yaṃ baṃ suṃ raṃ: nam mkha' rlung chu sa gzhi ri: 'bar ba'i gnas su bhrūm̐ 'phros pas: zhi khro 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: phyi nang rim gnyis rgyan gyis mdzes: gru chad gling dgu 'khor lo gsum: gtso 'khor 'tshams pa'i gdan dang bcas: rang gsal 'od kyi tshul du bsgom: rang byung a yi cho 'phrul las: zhi khro yi ge 'khor lo 'phros: so so'i gnas su 'khod par gyur: oṃ ā: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: kṣīṃ trāṃ hrīḥdzriṃ maiṃ thiṃlha hūm̐ mūṃ: hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha: he he he he he he he he: kreṃ trūṃ sruṃ braṃ kṣaṃ ye: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: a ni kun la khyab par thim: 'od zer tshogs 'phros rgyal ba mchod: byin rlabs kun bsdus gnyis med thim: zhi khro 'bar ba'i sku ru rdzogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra tsitta oṃ: a a a badzrī bha dra sa manta ā: dbus su rgyal ba kun tu bzang: mthing gsal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: dang pos rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bar pas byang chub mchog gi rgya: tha mas mnyam gzhag phyag rgya mdzad: rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: mtshan dpe rang rdzogs tshul dgu ldan: rgyan chas bcu gsum dag gis mdzes: kun tu bzang mo sku mdog mthing: phyag dang zhabs ni yab dang 'khril: bde stong nyams rgyas 'od zer 'bar: seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng: kun 'dus bdag nyid chen por bsgom: oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: mdun du che mchog he ru ka: mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum g.yas: dung dmar g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'dzin: zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal chas bcu: gnam zhal dbyings phyug nam mkha'i mdangs: dril bu dung dmar 'dzin nas 'khril: pad nyi dregs pa khyo shug steng: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par 'gying: ye shes me yi 'od 'bum 'phro: gtso bo'i g.yas dang phyogs bzhi ru: seng ge'i khri dang glang po che: rta mchog rma bya shang shang dang: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: hūm̐ badzra dhṛk mūṃ dhā twī shwa rī: oṃ dzi na dzik lāṃ dwe ṣa rā ti: swā ratna dhṛk māṃ mo ha rā ti: āṃḥ.a ro l̥k pāṃ rā ga rā ti:

hā pra dzñā dhṛk tāṃ badzra rā ti: rdo rje sems dpa' mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: phyag drug rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: dril bu padma ral gri g.yon na 'dzin: dbyings phyug sngon mo rdo rje dril 'dzin 'khril: rnam par snang mdzad dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen g.yas na bsnams: dril bu padma ral gri g.yon na 'dzin: spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dril 'dzin 'khril: rin chen 'byung ldan ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal: rin chen rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas na bsnams: dril bu padma ral gri g.yon na 'dzin: mā ma ki ser rin chen dril 'dzin 'khril: snang ba mtha' yas dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal: padma rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas na bsnams: dril bu rin chen ral gri g.yon na 'dzin: gos dkar dmar mo padma dril 'dzin 'khril: don yod grub pa ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas na bsnams: dril bu rin chen padma g.yon na 'dzin: sgrol ma ljang gu ral gri dril 'dzin 'khril: phung po khams lnga dag pa'i sku ru gsal: yab yum rdo rje padma'i skyil krung bzhugs: gtso bo'i g.yon dang 'khor lo nang ma yi: phyogs bzhir pad nyi dregs pa khyo shug steng: oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: badzra khrag 'thung mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: rdo rje ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: zhags pa lcags sgrog thong gshol g.yon na bsnams: badzra kro dhī rdo rje dung dmar stob: buddha khrag 'thung smug dkar dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo rgyu zhags dung khrag g.yas na 'dzin: thod khrag zhags pa mi mgo g.yon na bsnams: buddha kro dhī 'khor lo dung khrag stob:

ratna khrag 'thung ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal: rin chen dgra st+wa 'jig rten g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar rgyu zhags ri rab g.yon na bsnams: ratna kro dhī rin chen dung dmar stob: padma khrag 'thung dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal: padma dgra st+wa be con g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar thong gshol 'jig rten g.yon na bsnams: karma kro dhī padma thod khrag stob: karma khrag 'thung ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: rgya gram ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar thong gshol zhags pa g.yon na bsnams: padma kro dhī rgya gram 'dzin pa 'khril: mtshams bzhir padma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng: oṃ raksha shrī he ru ka raksha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ sa nu shrī he ru ka sa nu kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ gu hya shrī he ru ka gu hya kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ yaksha shrī he ru ka yaksha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: raksha khrag 'thung mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar tho ba zhags pa g.yon na bsnams: raksha dbyings phyug rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: sa nu khrag 'thung ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum thod rnga g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar thod dbyug mi mgo g.yon na bsnams: sa nu dbyings phyug kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa 'khril: gu hya khrag 'thung dud kha dkar dmar zhal: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ dbyug to g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar mdung thung rnga yab g.yon na bsnams: gu hya dbyings phyug gri gug 'dzin pa 'khril: yaksha khrag 'thung ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: rgya gram kha ṭwāṃ dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar ral gri zhing dbyug g.yon na bsnams: yaksha dbyings phyug ral gri 'dzin pa 'khril: de kun gar dgu dur khrod chas dang ldan: rdo rje gshog brgyang zhabs bzhi 'dor ba'i stabs: yab yum 'khril sbyor me yi klong du bzhugs: ye shes thig le dgu yi ngo bor gsal: 'khor lo bar pa'i phyogs kyi rtsibs rnams su: kṣiṃ hi rā dza ya:

hūm̐ lā sye sa ma ya st+waṃ: trāṃ ā garbha ya: trāṃ mā lye sa ma ya ho: hrīḥha hūm̐ padma pra dā ma: hrīḥgīrti rā ga ho: dzriṃ ku ru pā ṇi: ā nīrti rā ga ya mi: sa snying dkar po myu gu dril bu 'dzin: lā sya dkar mo me long dril 'dzin 'khril: nam snying ser po ral gri dril bu 'dzin: mā lye ser mo phreng ba dril 'dzin 'khril: spyan ras gzigs dmar padma dril bu 'dzin: glu ma dkar mo pi waṃ dril 'dzin 'khril: phyag na rdo rje mthing ga rdor dril bsnams: gar ma ljang gu gar bsgyur yab dang 'khril: padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: rnam shes yul bzhi dag pa'i sku ru gsal: 'khor lo bar pa'i mtshams kyi rtsibs rnams su: mai dha ra ṇi swā hā: dzaḥdhū pe pra be sha: thiṃlha nissa raṃ bha ya swā hā: hūm̐ puṣpe ā be sha: hūm̐ swa rā dza ya swā hā: baṃ dī pa su gi ri: mūṃ shrī a rā ga ya swā hā: ho gandhe tsitta: byams pa dkar ser klu shing dril bu bsnams: spos ma dkar ser spos khang dril 'dzin 'khril: sgrib sel dmar ser 'khor lo dril bu bsnams: me tog dmar ser me tog dril 'dzin 'khril: kun bzang dmar ljang snye ma dril bu bsnams: mar me dmar ljang mar me dril 'dzin 'khril: 'jam dpal dkar ljang utpal dril bu bsnams: dri chab dkar ljang dung phor dril bu 'dzin: yab rnams sems skyil yum rnams brtul zhugs kyis: 'khril sbyor padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dbang po dus bzhi dag pa'i sku ru gsal: zhi ba yab yum rgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes: 'khor lo phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams g.yas rtsibs la: oṃ badzra gau rī ha: oṃ badzra tsau rī ha: oṃ badzra pra mo he ha: oṃ badzra bai ta lī ha: oṃ badzra pukka sī ha: oṃ badzra ghasma rī ha: oṃ badzra sme sha nī ha: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī ha: mdzod ldan nag mo zhing dbyug bhandha 'dzin: chom rkun ser mo mda' gzhu 'gengs shing 'phen:

rab rmongs dmar mo chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar: ro langs nag mo rdo rje zhing chung thogs: sbos mo dmar ser rgyu ma 'dren cing za: dred mo ljang gu dung khrag rdo rjes dkrug: dur khrod mthing nag zhing chung glo snying za: gtum mo ser mo zhing chung mgo lus phral: khro mo'i chas can zhing gi gdan la rol: rnam shes brgyad po dag pa'i sku ru gsal: 'khor lo phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams g.yon rtsibs la: oṃ badzra siṃ ha mu kha he: oṃ badzra byā gṛ mu kha he: oṃ badzra sṛ la mu kha he: oṃ badzra shwa na mu kha he: oṃ badzra gṛ ḍha mu kha he: oṃ badzra kaṃ ka mu kha he: oṃ badzra khā kha mu kha he: oṃ badzra ū lu ka mu kha he: seng gdong ser mo ro za lag gnyis bsnol: stag gdong dmar mo lag gnyis thur du bsnol: wa gdong nag mo zhing chung lce yis ldag: khyi gdong mthing nag zhing gi khog pa phral: rgod gdong dmar mo zhing gi rgyu ma 'dren: dur bya'i gdong ma dmar mo zhing phrag khur: khwa gdong nag mo ral gri bhandha 'dzin: 'ug gdong mthing nag rdo rje dbyug pa phyar: zhing lpags gos dang thod rgyan bam gyi gdan: yul brgyad gnas su dag pa'i sku ru gsal: pho brang nang ma'i khyams kyi phyogs bzhi la: oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne truṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne braṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne kṣaṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne ye swā hā: shar lhor brgya byin dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin: byang du thags bzang mthing ga go mtshon 'dzin: lho ru shāka thub ser po gseg par bsnams: nub byang seng rab dmar nag pusti 'dzin: lho nub kha 'bar ser nag sgrom bu 'dzin: byang shar chos rgyal nag po me chu 'dzin: chags bral mchog gi sprul sku'i cha lugs can: 'gro ba'i don mdzad padma'i gdan la bzhengs: 'gro drug yul 'dzin dag pa'i sku ru gsal: pho brang shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi ru: hūm̐ ya mānta kṛta phaṭa:

oṃ badzra dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa li ni hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ pra dzñānta kṛta phaṭa: oṃ ratna dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa li ni hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ padmānta kṛta phaṭa: oṃ padma dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa li ni hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ bighnānta kṛta phaṭa: oṃ karma dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dzwa li ni hūm̐ phaṭa: gshin rje smug nag nṛ mgo gdengs pa thogs: khro mo smug nag lcags kyu 'dzin pa 'khril: stobs chen ser nag rdo rje dbyug pa phyar: khro mo ser nag zhags pa 'dzin pa 'khril: rta mgrin dmar nag thod dbyug sbrul dkris phyar: khro mo dmar nag lcags sgrog 'dzin pa 'khril: bdud rtsi 'khyil ljang rgya gram dbyug pa phyar: khro mo ljang nag dril bu 'dzin pa 'khril: dur khrod chas rdzogs 'dor stabs nyi ma'i gdan: log rtog mtha' bzhi bral ba'i sku ru gsal: pho brang nang ma'i sgo khyams rnams su ni: oṃ badzra ārya te dza te nga dza: oṃ badzra a mu khe hūm̐: oṃ badzra lo ka baṃ: oṃ badzra bhasmiṃ pā la ya ba tu ho: shar sgor rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: lho sgor phag gdong ser mo zhags pa bsnams: nub sgor sprel gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: byang sgor spyang gdong ljang mo dril bu thogs: skye rga na 'chi dag pa'i sku ru gsal: phyi sgo'i pho brang bar gyi khrag khyams la: ma nu raksha sī bhyo: brahma ṇī bhyo: rau trī bhyo: baiṣṇa bī bhyo: ku mā rī bhyo: ind+ra nī bhyo: shar du zhi ba'i las mdzad dbang phyug drug: srin mo smug nag g.yag gdong rtse gsum 'dzin: tshangs pa dmar ser sbrul gdong rtse lnga phyar: 'khrugs mo dmar ser gzig gdong dbyug to 'dzin: khyab 'jug dmar ser pha waṃ 'khor lo bskor: dbang mo dmar skya dred gdong bam dbyug phyar: brgya byin dkar dmar sre gdong thod khrag 'thung: badzra siṅga laṃ bhyo: a mṛtaṃ bhyo: sau ma bhyo:

daṇḍa daṃ bhyo: raksha sī bhyo: bhaksha sī bhyo: lho ru rgyas pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug drug: zhi ba dmar mo dom mgo rgyu zhags 'dzin: bdud rtsi chu srin sngon mo bum pa 'dzin: zhi ba sngo skya sdig gdong bam ril 'dzin: be con nag mo khra mgo thod rlon thogs: srin mo dmar nag wa gdong zhing rgyu 'dren: za byed nag mo stag mgo baṃ snying 'byin: rā ti badzra bhyo: ru dhi ra mattā bhyo: e ka tsa ri ṇī bhyo: ma no ha raṃ bhyo: siddhi kaṃ bhyo: bā ya bī bhyo: nub tu dbang gi las byed dbang phyug drug: dga' byed dmar mo rgod gdong 'khor lo 'dzin: khrag 'thung dmar mo rta gdong rdo rje 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo khyung gdong rdo rje 'dzin: 'dod pa dmar mo khyi gdong zhing chen za: nor srung dkar dmar pu shud padma 'dzin: rlung mo dmar skya sha mgo baṃ ro za: ma hā mā ra ṇī bhyo: agna ye bhyo: bā rā hī bhyo: tsa muṇṭī bhyo: su ta nāṃ bhyo: bā ru ṇī bhyo: byang du drag po'i las mdzad dbang phyug drug: gsod byed ljang nag spyang mo rnge'u chung bsnams: me mo ljang dmar skyin gdong gsal shing thogs: ma mo ljang ser phag gdong rtse gsum 'dzin: rgan byed ljang sngon khra mgo rgyu ma 'dren: sna chen ljang dmar glang mgo bam ro thogs: chu lha ljang nag sbrul gdong sbrul zhags 'dzin: badzra ma hā kā li bhyo: badzra tsa ka lā bhyo: badzra kumbha karṇā bhyo: badzra lambo dha rā bhyo: shar sgor khu byug nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: lho sgor ra gdong dmar mo rgyu zhags 'dzin: nub sgor seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: byang sgor skya ga ljang nag dril bu 'dzin: kun kyang dur khrod chas ldan zhing rkyang gdan: steng du rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: phyi rol dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: nyi ma las ni 'od zer ji bzhin du: rtog tshogs mkha' khyab lha ru ngang gis rdzogs:
chos dbyings mkha' klong yongs su gang bar

bsam: gsum pa dbang bskur byin rlabs ni/ rigs lnga'i dbang rgya spyi bo'i gnas lngar bcings shing*/ spyi bor rigs lnga snyoms 'jug chus: dug lnga'i sgrib sbyangs phung po lnga: gnas gyur rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā darsha dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā sa mā tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā pra tyā bekṣa ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā kṛ tyā nuṣṭhān dzñā na badzrā swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: gnas gsum zla ba pad nyi la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis: rgyal ba'i rdo rje gsum spyan drangs: thim pas rnam snang 'od dpag med: mi bskyod pa yi sku ru gyur: gnas gsum rdo rje'i rgya bcings la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā wā ka badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: bzhi pa ye shes dgug pa ni/ rang rig hūm̐ sngon rtag 'char ba'i: 'od kyis chos dbyings mthar thug khyab: chos sku gzugs sku'i skur bzhengs gyur: hūm̐: tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs thugs dam dbyings kyi lha: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rol pa chen po'i sku: rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag: thugs kyi rol pas bde chen dbyings nas bzhengs: badzra sa mā dza: nam mkha' gang bar byon par bsam: hūm̐: chos sku rig pa rang snang ba: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang: khams gsum ma lus 'dul ba yi: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas pa: rdo rje 'chang gral rim brnyes pa'i: rnal 'byor chen po'i rig 'dzin rnams: smon lam dam tshig tshul bzhin du: gnas 'dir ma lus gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e hye hi: ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo dza dza: lnga pa dam tshig gnyis med bsre ba ni/

hūm̐: thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing: byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang 'dren: lcags sgrog bka' yi pho nyas gnas bskyod la: bde gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dgyes pa bskyed: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: badzra sa ma ya mu dra ā: badzra he ru ka tiṣṭha sa ma ya lhan: drug pa mchod bstod ni/ rdo rje rkang lag mdzes pa'i gar: nam mkha'i rdul snyed rab sprul te: 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes bya'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: a ti pu ho: pra tītstsha ho: rgyas par phyag rgya bzhi yis mchod par bya'o// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyang: lha la lha rol tshul gyis ni: hūm̐: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hūm̐: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hū: yang dag don du dag mod kyang: 'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du: phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang: rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gdugs kyis 'gebs: byams pa thabs dang shes rab las: badzra dhū pe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhupe dhū: utpal mthing ga me tog 'thor: sna tshogs rin chen 'od du 'phro: snying rje thabs dang shes rab las: badzra puṣpe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: hrī: dbang gi phyag na sgron me bsnams: chos kyi rgyal po 'bar ba 'dzin: dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las: badzra ā lo ke'i mchod pa rol:

oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: tsandan bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma: dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'bebs: btang snyoms thabs dang shes rab las: badzra gandhe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa'i: bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar: dug lnga sel ba sman gyi mchog: rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: kā ya wāka tsitta siddhi oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: khams gsum chags pa'i 'dzin pa bsgral: chags med chags bral dmar chen po: dug gsum rnam par sbyong ba'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha rnams bzhes su gsol: ma hā rakta pra tītstsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa: ye shes lnga yi mchod sprin che: byin rlabs gtor ma'i mchod sprin 'di: mchod do bzhes shig dgyes par mdzod: ma hā ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs shes mnyam sbyor bde chen sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun mchod de: 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog thams cad bsgral: mnyam nyid spros bral ye mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa: dharma dhā tu shuddha ā: oṃ: phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi: ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che: bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs: snang stong thig le kun tu rdzogs ho: oṃ: rdo rje bsod nams thig le che: rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan: rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa: rdo rje rgyal po thig le che ho: oṃ: sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che: yon tan phrin las kun tu rdzogs: ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang: 'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che ho: oṃ: mi dmigs rdzu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings: mtha' yas kun nas lha tshogs spro: mtha' yas kun nas kun gyis thim: sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po hoḥ oṃ: phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rdul snyed du:

rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed: sprul pa'i rdul phran bsam yas kyis: skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub ho: oṃ: thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che: sku gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab: sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che ho: hūm̐: gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu ba bzhin: mche ba zang yag za byed che ho: hūm̐: rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir: gtum chen ri rab 'bum bsnyil skad: a la la yi gad rgyangs che: bshugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che ho: hūm̐: khro bo shes rab 'od po che: ye shes dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal: 'bar ba'i ye shes kun tu 'joms: sna tshogs ye shes thig le che ho: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po sprin chen po: 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor char chen 'bebs: dkyil 'khor ye shes 'byung ba'i gter: sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che ho: hūm̐: bdud kun gyi ni bdud chen po: bdud kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'joms: 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs byed pa: 'jigs byed chen po thig le che ho: hūm̐: rdo rje brag chen sra ba po: rdo rje chu ste sdud chen po: rdo rje me ste kun 'bar che: rdo rje rlung ste 'thor rlung che hoḥ spro na mchod pa bcu drug 'bul zhing bshags pa dam bca' dngos grub gsol ba rnams kyang bya'o// bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba la/ dzap khang dbye ba ni/ dbye gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe phaṭa dza: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhāṃ phaṭa dza: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bhyo raṃ phaṭa dza: zhes ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhugs par bsam/ bzlas dmigs ni/ mkha' khyab dkyil 'khor chen po ni: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: sems dpa' sum brtsegs gsal ba yi: dper na shel ltar 'tsher ba yi: 'od zer phar 'phros sgrib sbyang bskul: tshur 'phros rtog sgrib ma lus sbyangs:

dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod du gyur: 'od zer dmar po rā ga'i mdangs: phar 'phros ye shes mchod cing bskul: tshur 'phros dngos grub rnam pa gnyis: 'od zer tshul du bdag la thim: sngags sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar: grags stong brjod bral rang sgrar grags: mthing zhun lta bu'i 'od zer ni: phar 'phros rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul: tshur 'phros dngos grub chen po ni: bdag la bstsal zhing brtan par mdzad: ye nas gnyis med lhun grub pa'i: lhag pa'i chos sku chen por 'grub: yab yum zhal nas zhal du zhugs: mkha' nas mkhar drangs bde ba che: lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid: sa lam dus gcig der rdzogs gyur: phyag rgya sku mchog yi ge 'bru: phyag mtshan shin tu phra ba'i gzugs: mtha' yas spro bsdus don kun mdzad: lhag pa'i ting 'dzin 'byongs pa'i tshad: rlung sngags sems gsum dbyer med pa: rdo rje'i bzlas pa mchog tu bshad: ces bzlas nas lha so so'i bskyed sngags bzlas mthar/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: zhes zhi ba spyi sngags dang*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: zhes khro bo spyi sngags bzlas la/ las dang po pas 'dzab khang dbye ba bskyed bde yang*/ bskyed rdzogs byang pas ni/ hūm̐: 'khor ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las: sems can sangs rgyas snying po shar: sgra skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa: thams cad bzlas brjod sngags kyi tshig: lus kyi 'gul bskyod thams cad ni: dam tshig phyag rgya'i ngang du gnas: rang rig byang chub sems kyi ngang: bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang la gnas: snang srid chos rnams ma lus pa: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dkyil 'khor 'byams klas ngang du bsgom: zhes pa'i dgongs pa skyong la zhi khro'i spyi sngags bzla bar bya'o// las sbyor gyi bzlas pa byed par spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas/

khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa'i sham bur/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tīrya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces btags pa bzlas la/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba nyams chag dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa 'di bzlas pas rnal 'byor pa rtog sgrib can/ nyams chag can/ gsog 'jog can bag chags ngan pa can khyed rnams kyi nyams chag thams cad bskangs te ngan song du ltung ba'i las kyi sgrib pa las thar bar 'gyur ro// tshe 'di la yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sras kyi dam par dgongs nas srung zhing skyob par mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// zhes gnang ba byin par bsam mo// dbang bskur gnas lung sogs dang sbrel na bum pa'i 'dzab bya ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i bskyed chog ni mdun bskyed dang dbyer med yin pas zur du mi dgos la/ khrus bum ni/ rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang: padma 'dab brgya ge sar la: aḥlas yi ge'i 'khor lo spros: oṃḥbaḥdzraḥsaḥtwaḥsaḥmaḥyaḥmaḥnuḥpāḥlaḥyaḥbaḥdzraḥsaḥtwaḥtweḥnoḥpaḥtiṣaḥṭhaḥdṛḥḍhoḥmeḥbhaḥwaḥsuḥtoḥṣyoḥmeḥbhaḥwaḥsuḥpoḥṣyoḥmeḥbhaḥwaḥ.aḥnuḥrakaḥtoḥmeḥbhaḥwaḥsaraḥbaḥsidaḥdhiḥmmeḥpraḥyatsaḥtshaḥsaraḥbaḥkaraḥmaḥsuḥtsaḥmeḥtsitaḥtaṃḥshreḥyaḥkuḥruḥhūm̐ḥhaḥhaḥhaḥhaḥhoḥbhaḥgaḥwānaḥsaraḥbaḥtaḥthāḥgaḥtaḥbaḥdzraḥmāḥmeḥmunyaḥtsaḥbaḥdzrīḥbhaḥbaḥmaḥhāḥsaḥmaḥyaḥsaḥtwaḥ.āḥhūm̐ḥphaṭaḥ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas pa las: dbus su bcom ldan rdo rje sems: 'dab mar dam pa rigs brgya gsal: bzlas pa ni/ bum pa'i gzungs thag nas bzung ste/

rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang du song*/ lha yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis mdzad/ sku'i cha thams cad nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ zhi khro'i spyi sngags dang*/ yig brgya ci nus bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu ba'i bum chu bdud rtsir bsam mo// 'dzab khang bsdu ba ni/ spro na mchod bstod nongs bshags rgyas pa gong ltar bya/ bsdu na/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang sogs nas/ khā hi: oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: dam tshig ye shes kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis med du gyur par bsam/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ st+waṃ ho: dbang bskur skabs su/ oṃ: rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bdag gis slob ma 'jug par 'tshal: zhes thal mo sbyar te gsol ba btab pas gnang ba bstsal bar bsam mo// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bdun/ dang po tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la bsang chu gtor la/ oṃ kro dhī shwa rī sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ne hūm̐ phaṭa: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: hūm̐: ye shes me rlung chu 'phros pas: dngos 'dzin rnam rtog thams cad sbyang: tshogs gzhong bhandha'i snod nang du: sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga: 'dod yon mchod sprin 'phro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing: rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul: tshogs mchog dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: e hye hi: ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo dza dza: mchod pa gzhan yang spro bar bya/ oṃ: dgyes par tshim pa'i longs spyod dag: ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ltar: dpag bsam shing chen 'dod 'jo'i ba:

ma rmos lo tog rgyas pa ltar: rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po dag: nam mkha'i khams su gtibs nas kyang: rdo rje dgyes tshogs kun 'dus nas: skal ldan tshogs kyis rab sprul cing: rdo rje gar gyis dbang bsgyur nas: sgeg sogs lha mo'i 'jo tshul dag: 'dud cing bstod pa'i tshul gyis ni: rol mo'i tshogs kyis dgyes par mdzod: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra: i daṃ dhū pe puṣpe dī paṃ gandhe ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha ho: shrī māṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi: tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad: ngag gis tshig 'khyal smra ba ngan du brjod: sems kyis blo nor log par sems pa sogs: 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad rtsom: nongs shing 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis mthol lo bshags: yig brgya bzlas shing dag par bsam: ming gzugs la bris dgra bgegs bkug: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bskul byas na: sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig: bdud rtsi lnga dang zas lnga la: mtshan ma ming dang bcas pa bya: bkug ste rdo rje phur pas bsgral: rdul du brlags nas tshogs su 'bul: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: sarba duṣṭān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

log 'dren bdud rtsir sbar nas 'bul: hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs mchod 'di: mchod sprin kun tu rgyas gyur cig: dug gsum brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du stob: ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: brda dang brda yi 'bul len gyis: lus dkyil lha tshogs tshogs kyis mchod: rnal 'byor gsang ba'i spyod pa bskyang: gtsang sme mchod ras mar me bcas: shar lhor maṇḍal steng du bzhag: oṃ bhrūm̐: lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan bcas pa: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal: snod ni zla ba bcud hrīḥdamar: mtheb srin phyag rgyas reg nas su: oṃ badzra a mṛta a dhiṣṭhā māṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: dam rgyas gtor mar dmar chen 'bebs: oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra: ā gatstsha ya: ā gatstsha ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhandha ya: bhandha ya: to ṣa ya: to ṣa ya: sarba badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: bshugs glu bya zhing lhag mgron 'bod: dam rgya dpral bar g.yon gsum bskor: so so'i gnas su 'khod par bsam: oṃ ḍā ki ā karṣa ya: ā karṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhandha ya: bhandha ya: to ṣa ya: to ṣa ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ḍā ki hūm̐ phaṭa: 'dod pa'i las rnams byed par bsam: rta gdong snyems pas phyag rgya bya: hrīḥpadma ba ḍa bā mu kha: ā karṣa ya: ā karṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhandha ya: bhandha ya: to ṣa ya: to ṣa ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ha ha hi hi: dbang du 'dus shing bka' sdod bsam: mgron rnams rigs lnga'i tshom bu ru: bzhugs shing gtor ma bzhes par bsam: he ru ka yi thod rgya bya: oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta oṃ phaṭa: oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta trāṃ phaṭa:

oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hrīḥphaṭa: oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta āḥphaṭa: gtor ma phud bcas sme bar blugs: lce ni rta mgrin yab yum gnyis: sbyor ba'i byang sems dza gad kyi: kha phru dam rgyas 'debs par bya: oṃ gu ru kro dha ratna sa ma ya pri sha sarba buddha kṣe tra pā la kṣo bha kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: rigs lnga dpal chen he ru ka: khro mo gau rī siṃ ha dang: 'bar ma sgo skyong gsang ba'i yum: mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs su sprul: dregs pa srin mo'i tshogs rnams btul: lhag ma byin nas dam la btags: sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sman dang rakta gtor mas mchod: ho: lhag ma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phud dang gtor ma bzhes su gsol: dam tshig nyams chag skong bar mdzod: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub par mdzod: ya hi gatstsha sa rang gnas gshegs: lhag gtor khor yug phyi rol dor: lhag dkyil hūm̐ gis rang la bsdu: gnyis pa gtor skyong ni/ bka' srung gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir spel la/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru kas: gsang sngags rgyud lung mang po bstan pa dang: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams dang: lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas mchog tu: rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral gyis: gsang sngags rgyud lung bsdu ba mdzad pa dang: de 'og lha klu mi yi yul rnams su: shākya thub pa rigs gsum mgon po yis: gsang sngags phyi nang chos rnams gsungs pa dang: de rjes las can drwa ma lnga rnams dang: rgyal bas lung bstan skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ ind+ra bhū ti nā ga pu tra dang: dga' rab rdo rje rdo rje bzhad pa rtsal: pra bha hasti shākya seng ge sogs:

grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon thams cad kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa rgya cher spel ba dang: khyad par yang le shod kyi gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng gis: dpal chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: ma mo mkha' 'gro dregs pa dbang du bsdus: brgyud gsum bla ma'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam bzhin du bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: gtor ma phud kyis bran nas su: trāṃ ratna trai lo kya phaṭa: gtor ma'i rdul phran re re bzhin: rin chen gur khyim longs spyod gyur: 'bru gsum dag gis byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid: khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ la lā: le le: taṃ taṃ: te te: kha rakma: ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: gsum pa bro brdung ba ni/ bro ra las bzhi'i dbyibs su byas nas/ yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes zhi ba chen po rnams: thugs rje chen pos bro brdungasapas: gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: nyon mongs bdud dang mi mthun tshogs: yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad pa: zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ngo mtshar brjid pa chen po rnams: rngams pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams: yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzad: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: waṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du:

bde ba chen po'i gar bsgyur rnams: chags pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: rgyal blon pho mo 'bru nor rnams: yud tsam gyis ni dbang du sdud: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: ru dra dgra bgegs ma lus pa: yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzad: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzlas bro brdung ngo: bzhi pa dngos grub len pa ni bdud rtsi btung zhing*/ hūm̐: sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed de: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rnams: bdag la bstsal cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: kā ya wā ka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra: zhes dngos grub gsol zhing dbang blang ngo*// lnga pa nyer bsdu ni/ mchod bstod nongs bshags gong ltar byas la rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na ye shes pa gshegs sam rang la bsdu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid dkyil 'khor rang la thim: sems dpa' gsum yang hūm̐ la 'dus: de yang dbyings ye gnyis med pa'i: byang chub thig le'i klong du bzhag: drug pa rgyun gyi spyod lam ni/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sngags kyi rkyen gyis sad pa las: dpal chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: badzra kā wā tsi rakṣa haṃ: lus ni rdo rje'i go yis g.yogs/ badzra ka pā la mā lā a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ: oṃ ārya lambo dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: dbu rgyan cod pan la sogs bcing*/ oṃ gu hya sa ma ya st+waṃ: bdun pa bsngo ba dang bkra shis spyi ltar bya'o// kun tu bzang po'i rgyal thabs nas 'ongs pa'i// zhi khro na raka dong sprugs sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud lung man ngag rtsibs stong mu khyud can// byin rlabs 'od zer mtha' yas spro ba 'di// rgyal sras spyod pa can gyis thogs tsam gyis// ngan 'gro srid pa'i rgud mun las grol te// rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyal srid rab tu thob// 'gro rnams phan bde'i dpal la dkri bar shog/
